notes.title: Early Access - Patch 2
notes.notes:
Greetings, we're releasing this patch to address the feedback we have received.
[h2]New Additions[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Introducing [b]DroneCams[/b], Look at the map from 3 different perspectives - [i]Traditional Tower Defense Style[/i]
[*] Enemy ragdolls [Quality & Duration can be adjusted from the settings menu]
[*] Enemy hit effect, Enemies will be highlighted when they receive damage
[*] Various sound effects [Button interaction, Mode Changes, Building etc]
[*] Seizure warning before the game starts
[*] Key and mice prompts
[*] Variety of new foliage
[*] Muzzle flash for projectile weapons
[*] Bullet hit effect based on material hit
[*] Performance warning for foliage and ragdoll settings
[/olist]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Revamped Player HUD
[*] [url=https://youtu.be/dwQwwul3efs]Revamped First Level [Ghar][/url]
[*] Beacon color and intensity [Brightness] can now be adjusted from the settings menu
[*] UI hit marker, Hit sound and enemy hit effect can now be adjusted from the settings menu
[*] Player can now access incoming enemies panel from anywhere by pressing "I" button
[*] Player can now hover over the upgrade button to see upgrade potential of the turret
[*] Enemy health bar can now be seen by hovering crosshair over them
[*] Changed font from "Roboto Light" to "[url=https://www.1001fonts.com/squares-bold-font.html]Squares Bold[/url]"
[*] Improved lighting across all maps
[*] Changed particle effects for almost everything
[*] Changed foliage models
[*] Game size on disk increased from 2.5 GB to 3.4 GB
[/olist]
[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Adjusted number of pre existing turrets for first 3 maps
[*] Increased airstrike radius and damage
[*] Decreased airstrike prices
[*] Decreased ammo prices 
[*] Decreased player shield and shield upgrade prices
[*] Decreased armor upgrade prices
[*] Reduced damage received from enemy homing missiles
[/olist]

Thank you for your valuable feedback, We look forward to receiving more feedback from the community to further improve the gameplay experience.
